vBRIEFInfo.description: Epic scope xBRIEF for #1709 (Directive value attribution & adoption loop). Parent of the decomposed swarm-ready story cohort.

narratives.Description: Make directive's value legible to consumers along four axes -- value delivered, boundary awareness, adoption awareness, and gap escalation -- without lying, nagging, or spending consumer tokens unless they opt in. Every value claim is attributed to a concrete logged event; the whole feature is gated behind a typed policy flag that defaults OFF.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Land the opt-in/token-cost policy gate first (foundational), then the attribution ledger on the existing events infra, the capability adoption registry, the budgeted awareness readbacks, the confirmation-gated upstream gap escalation, and finally the institutionalization/propagation across AGENTS.md and templates. Each child is an independently buildable story with its own file scope and verification.
narratives.Acceptance: The four signal classes (value/bypass/adoption/friction) are attributable, opt-in-gated, and surfaced via a budgeted session line plus a pull-based readout, with a confirmation-gated upstream feedback path -- all no-ops when the policy flag is OFF.

items.title: Opt-in typed policy gate is foundational and gates all downstream signals

narrative.Acceptance: When plan.policy.valueFeedback.enabled is false, no events emit, no session line renders, and no upstream prompt fires.

items.title: Attribution, adoption, readbacks, and escalation compose on the gate

narrative.Acceptance: The ledger, registry, readbacks, and feedback path all short-circuit on the master flag and are individually sub-flag controllable.

references.title: Issue #1709: Epic: Directive value attribution & adoption loop (RFC)
Opt-in typed policy gate for value feedback (default OFF)
